deprecated_features.quote: The interleaving of write data with different IDs was permitted in AXI3, but is deprecated in AXI4 and later. See
Use of the Inner Shareable domain is deprecated in ACE5 and ACE5-Lite. See Shareability domain support on
Shareable domain is deprecated in the following interfaces:

backward_compat_traps.axi3: AxLEN[3:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN[3:0] + 1; burst length 1-16 transfers for all burst types
backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxLEN[7:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN[7:0] + 1; INCR up to 256; FIXED/WRAP still 1-16
backward_compat_traps.trap: AXI3 master + AXI4 slave (or vice versa) without burst-length translation: AXI3 master can never request more than 16-beat bursts but AXI4 slave default registers may decode the upper bits as junk.
Locked-access semantics silently dropped when AXI3 master targets AXI4 slave.

backward_compat_traps.axi3: BVALID may precede AW handshake (depends only on W handshake + WLAST).
backward_compat_traps.axi4: BVALID may only be asserted after BOTH (AW handshake AND W handshake with WLAST=1).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Straight AXI3-on-AXI4 wrapper must serialise; otherwise AXI4 slave may stall waiting for AW that the wrapper has not yet propagated.

backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxQOS (4 bits) + AxREGION (4 bits) sideband added.
backward_compat_traps.trap: AXI3 sources must tie AxQOS/AxREGION to 0; otherwise default-slave decode behavior is implementation-defined.

backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxCACHE[3:0] bit semantics reinterpreted ('Cacheable' renamed 'Modifiable' etc.).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Blind passthrough creates subtle correctness bugs; memory attribute interpretation must be re-validated at AXI3↔AXI4 boundary.

fields.version_naming_history_note: AXI specification versions v1.0 and v2.0 (used in Issues B and C) have been discontinued to avoid confusion with AXI3 / AXI4. Issue E.a was originally published before Issue F; AXI5 introduced in Issue G (2021).
